body:
VERDICT: BLOCK exact 7ba9356a50f4cdc64e1562d0eab8cf2d5fc75436. Sole parent/base e584ad6, sole assigned path, diff-check clean. The view/recall-derived identity, one-effective-set, view-absent-anchor, and complete-Credence findings are all closed by sections 5.0 and M14-M17.

HIGH — the ablation publication gap is identified but still not frozen into a court. The new section 8 bullet correctly states that current AblationResult carries only rows, viterbi and logLikelihood and that M9 can pass while the published result loses which removal produced it. But it then names only the migration surface: it does not require AblationResult or a content-addressed companion to retain the checked original bundle identity, typed removed channel/policy, derived ablated bundle/output identity, and it adds no mutation for dropping or substituting that publication evidence. By the document own rule, this remains a description rather than a requirement. Required successor: state the carrier relation and add a named mutation that changes or removes ablation provenance on the published AblationResult/companion while numeric rows/path/logLikelihood remain fixed; the court must turn red.

MEDIUM / GATE RECONCILIATION — section 10 still limits the exact source checklist to candidates.scala even though the accepted amendments now rely on Estimate at estimate.scala:61-67 and GraphHsmm/AblationResult at hsmm.scala:483-590. Expand the checklist to every cited source site so future drift cannot leave the frozen court source-false.

PLAN RECONCILIATION: all previous blockers except the ablation publication court are closed. ERGONOMIC RECONCILIATION: docs-only. VERIFIED: exact delta from blocked 59a557b, full successor, cited source, parent/path/diff-check. INFERRED: future carrier vocabulary remains ADR work.
